scope: Thursday only — IND Colts @ HOU Texans
historical_cutoff: Completion of Week 10 (2026-11-16); no Week 11 games included
percentile_method: User override: P7/P15/P16 calculated from the same locked L10 sample using Type 7 linear interpolation.

selection_method.historical_gate: Selected threshold must have L10 HR >= 7/10.
selection_method.context: Use Stage 3 current-week classification and supporting facts; Concern candidates are not selected absent a compelling reason.
selection_method.distribution: Use locked L10 P15 as a lower-tail reference and report threshold minus P15; P15 is descriptive, not a predictive probability.
selection_method.price: Use the locked DraftKings alternate price from Stage 2; no FanDuel price inferred.
selection_method.portfolio: Stage 4 selects props only; portfolio construction remains Stage 5.
